description: Add an `Assisted-by: <agent-name>/<model-id>` git trailer to commits made during an AI-assisted coding session. Trigger on any `git commit` activity visible in the session — either commits you make yourself, or commits the user makes outside your tool calls that surface in the conversation — even without an explicit request. Also trigger when the user explicitly asks to tag existing commits in a branch (e.g. "add assisted-by to commits in this branch").
